intention: survey's floor resolves a PATH ref to the component that owns it — the same question constrain's floor already answers with address.component_of — so a ref that is a path produces its census row instead of falling through to a bare existence check.
why:
MEASURED 2026-08-14 BY RUNNING THE CHAIN, not by reading the code. Stage 3 of the live chart chain for `constrain-discovers-and-runs-the-instruments-that-will-judge-the-build` returned `census_rows: []` against four grounded refs, two of which are real component addresses. Nothing redded, because an empty list is a legal list — the same silence that hid this defect's sibling in constrain.

THE LINE IS survey.py:118 — `if ref in roster and ref in rows` — where `roster` holds bare NAMES. Since orient's floor started grounding its refs (2026-08-14, ticket orient-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured) a ref is a path far more often than a name. A path ref matches neither condition, falls through to `ref_exists`, and lands in `refs_found`: measured as existing, and stripped of the census row that was the whole reason survey has a floor. The floor then reports WHAT EXISTS as a list of strings, and the ceiling supplies from scratch the holdings the floor was built to hand it.

THIS IS THE THIRD INSTANCE OF ONE SHAPE, and that is the finding rather than the line. constrain's floor discarded 86% of its input the same way and its ticket recorded the cause; orient's floor was the build that changed refs from names to paths and thereby created the mismatch downstream; survey is the third stage keyed on the old assumption. A build that changes what a stage EMITS silently changes what every later stage RECEIVES, and nothing in the chain announces that — each stage's gate checks its own packet's shape, and a shape can be perfectly legal while carrying a kind of value the next floor cannot use.

THE LIVED SYMPTOM: survey's holdings are what decompose is allowed to compose from — `decompose_composes_holdings` refuses a compose piece whose address is not in the survey berth. So a floor that contributes no census rows does not merely under-inform; it narrows what the NEXT stage is permitted to build out of, to exactly what the ceiling remembered to type. The preamble's deterministic half quietly stops carrying the build.
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel. `address.component_of` already answers 'given a path, which component owns it' and shipped on 2026-08-14 with the deepest-ancestor rule proved. Every caller that re-derives it, or gives up as this one does, is re-deriving a settled answer.
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. That survey's floor was contributing was assumed for as long as it has run; one live chain run said `census_rows: []`.
Law 9 — red is the default, green is earned. An empty list is a legal list, so this floor has been reporting success while producing nothing, and no instrument said otherwise.
Akien 2026-08-14 — 'we keep on until this whole skills and mechanical workflow is solid'. This is the chain's own deterministic half not carrying, found by running it.
gates: (1) USE THE PRIMITIVE THAT EXISTS: address.component_of, deepest-ancestor rule, built and proved for exactly this question — a second idea of which component owns a path is the drift Law 1 forbids and constrain's own history already records the cost of. (2) A NAME REF MUST KEEP WORKING. Refs are still sometimes bare names and the roster path is correct for those; this adds a resolution, it does not replace one. (3) THE FOUR FAILURE KINDS STAY TOLD APART, as constrain's floor already tells them: an ambiguous name, a roster/lookup disagreement, a string naming neither component nor existing path, and a real path under NO component (commons files, skills, top-level scripts — ordinary, not red). Collapsing them hands a reader a sentence instead of a diagnosis. (4) THE DUPLICATE THAT CONSTRAIN FOUND WILL APPEAR HERE TOO: once paths resolve, a component named BOTH by name and by path in the same orient packet yields its census row twice, and the duplicate is invisible to inspection because the rows are identical. A count tooth catches it; reading the output does not.
falsifier: DONE when the chain re-run over the same orient berth returns census rows for both component refs, name refs still resolve, a path under no component still reports as ordinary rather than red, and a component named twice yields one row. WRONG INTENT if: (1) the roster is taught to hold paths — that widens a name registry into a second address resolver and is the drift gate (1) exists to stop; (2) orient is changed to emit names again to make this stage work — the floor adapts to its input, and grounded refs were the point of that build; (3) the fix ships without the duplicate tooth, because the failure is identical rows that read as a longer list of correct answers.

distinctions_recorded: FOUND BY RUNNING THE CHAIN, WHICH IS THE PREAMBLE EARNING ITS KEEP AT n=1. This defect had been standing since orient's floor started grounding refs and no reading of the code surfaced it. Stage 3 fired against a real request and returned an empty list where two rows belonged. That is the argument for the whole chain compressed into one observation, and it is recorded here because the chain is itself the thing under construction.

AN EMPTY LIST IS A LEGAL LIST, AND THAT IS THE MECHANISM OF SILENCE IN ALL THREE INSTANCES. constrain emitted an empty constraint list for 86% of its input; survey emits an empty census_rows; neither reddened anywhere. A floor that can contribute nothing without saying so is indistinguishable from a floor with nothing to contribute, and telling those apart is a separate and more general question than this ticket's line fix.

A STAGE THAT CHANGES WHAT IT EMITS CHANGES WHAT EVERY LATER FLOOR RECEIVES, AND NOTHING ANNOUNCES IT. Each stage's gate checks its own packet's shape, and the shape here was always legal — a list of strings, before and after. What changed was the KIND of string. This is the chain's real coupling and it is invisible to every door in it.

THE COST IS PAID BY decompose, NOT BY survey. `decompose_composes_holdings` refuses a compose piece whose address is not in the survey berth, so an under-filled holdings list narrows what the next stage is PERMITTED to build from. A floor that under-informs is a nuisance; a floor that under-informs a gate is a constraint nobody authored.
